mode.post_interview: After the interview, half of cases are decided within ~{months} (attorney reports; low confidence).
mode.interview_scheduled: Your interview is scheduled for {date}. We expect the decision to come after the interview, although USCIS sometimes decides earlier (low confidence).
mode.interviewPassed: Your interview date ({date}) has passed. Did you have the interview? If so, record it in your case.
mode.post_expedite: Your expedite request was granted; we use a typical time of ~{months} from the grant (low confidence).
deadline.rfe: Your response to the Request for Evidence (RFE) is due {date}.
deadline.noid: Your response to the Notice of Intent to Deny (NOID) is due {date}.
deadline.rule: Since {since}, USCIS gives at most {weeks} weeks to answer an RFE and {noid} days for a NOID.
deadline.nonResponse: If you did not answer in time, USCIS may deny the case; if you did answer, record the date in your case.
deadline.applied: The estimate already accounts for the wait until your response.
decided.title: Your case already has a decision
decided.body: Your case shows as {outcome} ({date}). We do not compute estimates for decided cases.
decided.denialLink: See what you can do after a denial
error.title: We could not calculate
error.body: Check your case details: entry "{channel}", I-485 filed in {month}. The rest of the app's data is still available.
entry.title: Notes about your entry
entry.paroled: Your entry with parole counts for the Cuban Adjustment Act even if the parole has since ended.
entry.visa: You entered with a visa (inspected and admitted); that meets the Cuban Adjustment Act entry requirement.
entry.unknown: We do not know how you entered; the clock shows both possibilities. You can correct it in your case.
entry.redEagle: Under the definition published by the court (N.D. Cal. {docket}, {date}), your case appears to be in the class. USCIS has not published a channel for class members.
entry.filedAfterRedEagle: Your I-485 was filed after {date}, so it does not appear to be in the Red Eagle class.
entry.doeDhs: Under the published definition (D. Mass. {docket}), your case appears to be in the Doe v. DHS class.
entry.doeDhsUnknown: Your case could be in the Doe v. DHS class (D. Mass. {docket}); it depends on your parole date and on whether you received the April 2025 termination e-mail.
entry.frp: Under the family reunification carve-out (FR {fr}), your parole continues until it expires or until a final I-485 decision, because you filed the I-485 on or before {date}.
guard.T20a: USCIS has not published new monthly data since {month}.
